title: PromptReel Weekly: 3D worlds from one skill (Nov 2, 2026)
html:
PromptReel Weekly · Nov 2, 2026

This week: skills that build whole 3D worlds and the design-skill repos everyone is starring.

  1. 3D machine simulator from code with one free Claude Code skill by @elvar_official
    A 3D machine teardown simulator, built from a single installable skill.
  2. Roblox-style story Short from one Claude prompt by @finnardley
    Turns a one-line story idea into a Roblox-style Short.
  3. Claude Opus 5.5 coded a full 3D cinematic in Blender by @zer0point_eth
    A one-minute mascot video researched and coded by Claude.
  4. Claude Code redesigns a coffee shop site 100 times by @nateherk
    Iterative bold-change loop that redesigns a site over and over.
  5. Gemini 4 vs Opus 5.5: 15-second motion graphics showreel by @leo114119
    Same showreel prompt, two models head to head.

Trending repos

  • pbakaus/impeccable (+12,017 stars this week): Design vocabulary for your coding agent: polish, critique, audit.
  • Nutlope/hallmark (+11,566 stars this week): Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
  • cloudflare/security-audit-skill (+10,069 stars this week): Multi-phase security audit skill with verified findings.

Prompt tip: start with a one-line input slot (e.g. "Ask me for my story idea in one line") so the model interviews you before generating.
